description: This file defines a GUI component for a media player within the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes classes for clickable labels, a media player dock widget with volume and mute controls, and logging functions for MPV player integration.

classes.name: Clickable_label
classes.description: A QLabel subclass that emits a signal when clicked, used for visualizing frames for geometric measurements.

classes.name: DW_player
classes.description: A QDockWidget subclass that encapsulates a media player with controls for volume, mute, and frame viewing, integrated with MPV.

methods.name: mpv_logger
methods.description: Redirects MPV log messages to the general logging system.

methods.name: Clickable_label.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the clickable label with an ID and optional parent.

methods.name: Clickable_label.mousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events and emits a signal with the label ID and event.

methods.name: DW_player.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the media player dock widget, sets up UI components, and connects signals.

methods.name: DW_player.volume_slider_moved
methods.description: Emits a signal when the volume slider is moved.

methods.name: DW_player.mute_action_triggered
methods.description: Emits a signal when the mute button is triggered and updates icon.

methods.name: DW_player.keyPressEvent
methods.description: Emits a signal when a key is pressed on the widget.

methods.name: DW_player.resizeEvent
methods.description: Emits a signal when the widget is resized.
